tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand navy, the upper sky of the app icon. Night panels, hero slabs and the icon tile, in both themes.

tokens.name: night-deep
tokens.usage: Brand navy, the lower sky of the app icon. The deepest night panel and the terminal, in both themes.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: The icon's gold crescent. Fills only: primary buttons, the moon itself, highlights on night panels. On a light ground use `moon-text` for words.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Night Shift's warm tint. Fills that show the screen warmed: the tinted screen, the warm half of a before/after. Never for status.

tokens.name: starlight
tokens.usage: Text on `night` and `night-deep` panels in either theme (12.4:1 and 16.2:1).

tokens.name: starlight-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `night` and `night-deep` panels in either theme (6.6:1 and 8.7:1).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: the night sky at night, a pale dawn by day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sections and cards that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating things: the menu mock, popovers. Pair with `shadow-lift`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only; a control's edge uses `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: secondary buttons, inputs (at least 3.8:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (at least 12.4:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`: captions, subtitles, metadata (at least 6.5:1).

tokens.name: moon-text
tokens.usage: Gold words and links on `ground` and `surface` (12.9:1 at night, 5.2:1 by day).

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Warm words on `ground` and `surface`, for naming Night Shift's tint in running text (9.8:1 at night, 4.7:1 by day).

tokens.name: on-moon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `moon` and `ember` fills (12.9:1 and 8.7:1).

tokens.name: true-colour
tokens.usage: True colour, ember's counterpart: marks what the screen looks like with Night Shift off, such as a moment in the evening when a rule holds it off. Marks only, never text or fills (7.4:1 on `ground` by night, 4.1:1 by day).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Night Shift's tint as an overlay on a screenshot or a mock screen. Fade it, never flash it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring around any control, offset 2px (at least 9.9:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The app's check mark: a check that's fine. Always with its circle-check shape. The light value is the app's own and only 2.5:1 on `ground`: never use it alone.

tokens.name: drift
tokens.usage: The app's warning triangle: a problem where something the user set up stopped working, and the menu-bar dot. The light value is the app's own and only 2.2:1 on `ground`: always with the triangle.

tokens.name: broken
tokens.usage: The app's x mark: a broken file, or Night Shift unavailable. Always with its x-circle shape.

tokens.name: off
tokens.usage: The app's minus mark: off by choice, or not needed. The light value is the app's own and only 2.3:1 on `ground`: always with the minus shape and a word.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The landing page's one headline. Once per page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: Gives it back when you leave
styles.usage: Feature titles and the wordmark beside the icon. The smallest size Caprasimo is set at.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Nightcap switches Night Shift off while the apps and websites you choose are in front.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The rest of the time it follows your Night Shift schedule.
styles.usage: Running text, at most 65 characters a line.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, the line under a download button.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: FOR MAC · FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
styles.usage: Eyebrows and section labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: CLI commands and config, in the terminal and inline.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Rule identities, versions, times: anything a user might type back.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a mark and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page's side gutter on phones; padding inside small cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and the terminal.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The side gutter on wide screens; between a headline and what it introduces.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Between sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small tiles, as in the app's Settings.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, groups, the terminal and the menu mock, as the app's groups.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile: macOS's icon corner, 185 on an 824 body. Only for icon-shaped tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button: the app's buttons are capsules.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The app icon's drop shadow. Also the menu mock and anything else that floats; nothing else casts a shadow.
